calibration: temperature fit on calibration partition only; separate held-out score-calibration half for conformal sets
conformal_score: 1 - probability of true target; ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) order statistic; inclusive ties; all labels if rank exceeds n
model_selection: minimum tuning negative log likelihood per seed; no final-test selection
policy: No image downloads, no private wardrobe data, no taste or preference inference, no production ranking changes. All seeds and failures reported. No hyperparameter tuning after final test.
statistical_limit: Coverage guarantees require exchangeability; official validation and missing-context stress are empirical audits, not guaranteed coverage in a user wardrobe population.
stress: deterministically remove half of visible context categories, retaining at least one; same test targets and units
task: Recover one deterministically masked main-apparel category from the remaining unordered category set in one annotated image.
test_partition: official val2020, excluding source groups present in train2020
uncertainty: Wilson interval for descriptive accuracy and set coverage; paired bootstrap difference against co-occurrence by source-image unit, 2000 replicates
unit: one source-image group; deterministic representative and one masked target per group
